bindingConditions.text: While a result has planValidity REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION (a pending UNREPORTED_TRAINING question, a HOLD such as R4, or a clinical dependency), no consumer presents the stored run doses ahead as a prescription. The question, and any strength change kept beside it, are the only actionable items. Carry this in the freeze record and the handoff.

The answer path is low-friction and factual: done or not done per session, or a declared break with its reason, screened clinically. HealthKit evidence is used before asking where available. Non-response never falls back silently to credit or zero. While referenceState.pending.signal is present, the answer is delivered as a plain review of that week or as the pending event kind with its signals. An answer inside another event kind is followed by the held signal re-submitted before the plan is presented. A RECOVERED event does not carry the answer (it stays ASK). After a clinical route, the answer is kept and re-sent, or asked again, after qualified clearance (R5). Cadence and wording belong to G03.

The closure records the following as disclosed residuals, with this record's corrections. D1. B2. The B1 observation. The ratified fifth fixture. R1 at its measured magnitude (up to EASY 50 / QUALITY 34 / LONG 55, and a race touch in race week, until the next decision). R2 with A* as the only differing reference. R3 persisting one step into the following week. R4. R5. The SD-03 non-review route (SSCTR-SD5-02).

Engine, in the next runtime revision: a held reactive signal is never cleared without being re-evaluated. Any decision that answers the question either re-evaluates it, or keeps it pending with the plan REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION until the signal kind is re-submitted, or at least discloses it. Until then, the consumer obligation in C3 applies.

This applies after an answer to UNREPORTED_TRAINING that leaves sessions of the answer week elapsed before it, including the taper-to-race-week case. The following week's conditional projection is not presented or delivered as a prescription until a decision re-plans it: the answer week's review, or the first decision of the next week. The client triggers that decision at the week boundary. Carry this in the freeze record and the handoff, as C2 is carried. Engineering, before any use beyond the offline reference: re-project later weeks without crediting those elapsed unreported sessions (read them as unknown), or mark the projection as conditional on the week's review. Add a directed test that pins week b+1 after a day-2 known-stop answer.

metadata.writtenBy: evaluateProgram (normalizeObservations with recordArrival): the clock of the decision whose input first carried a report of that execution into the completed-work record; never taken from the input; carried unchanged; one execution (an agreeing duplicate, a correction and what it corrects) keeps the earliest
metadata.readBy: answeredOnRecord / unreadRunReports only: a report of a week a review closed is unread by it when the record first held it after that review's clock (evidenceThrough)
notReadBy: the learning model (normalizations without recordArrival keep no clock)
metadata.whyNeeded: Without it a late report and an on-time report of a run done short are the same canonical facts (same ledger rows, timestamps, gates and stored states; only the review's reason text differs), so no rule on the existing structures can read the first as unread and the second as read (QE-R7C-10 requires both).
metadata.backwardBehaviour: A record written before R7C-FREEZE-4 carries no first-recorded clock: for such a report the R7C-FREEZE-3 reading stands (legacyUnreadWeeks: the gate-class rule, sound for full-dose and adverse answers; a shortened late answer on such a record reads as on R7C-FREEZE-3). Nothing is migrated: the arrival of those reports was never recorded and is not invented.

conditions.status: CARRIED; r5 clause replaces the r4 clause (narrowed: adverse answers removed, mixed answers kept)
conditions.text: r2 text, plus (r5): Since R7C-FREEZE-3 an answer to UNREPORTED_TRAINING that a refusal (the R4 HOLD) or a handler clinical route (a substitution with pain, a clinical return report) recorded is applied by the first eligible decision after it (after qualified clearance for a clinical route), with no re-send, as the same answer delivered directly. Measured: known stops, executed and adverse answers in every cell; mixed answers in most. Residual: a mixed answer (some runs of the window reported done, some reported not done) recorded by a handler clinical route is not applied, re-send included, when a week of the window was closed by a review that saw none of its run reports and that week has a run reported done but no run role reported done in full; after clearance the next decisions keep the stored run doses of the answer week as VALID (for example QUALITY 34 / LONG 60 where the direct answer plans EASY 45 / LONG 50). Until an engine fix, after a handler clinical route that recorded a mixed answer, the run doses remaining in that week are not presented as a prescription; the qualified human's clearance and the week's own review decide, and that review re-plans the following week from the facts. An eligibility clinical flag still records nothing, so its answer is re-sent after clearance (R5).

conditions.status: CARRIED (r4 text) with r5 changes to R3, R4 and R5 and the reach added
conditions.text: The closure records as disclosed residuals: D1. B2. B1. The ratified fifth fixture. R1: fixed on the factual re-plan route; persisting on handler routes that re-compose the weeks from the answer week (a nonclinical EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION, a short RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE, an EVENT_DATE_CHANGE): week b+1 stored up to EASY 50/QUALITY 34/LONG 60, and a 25-minute race touch in race week after a taper answer, until the first decision of the next week, which in every measured case asks or re-plans within the single-run ceiling. R2 with A* as the only differing reference (the one-step differences at the first decision of week b+1 belong here). R3 persisting one step into the following week; on the answer path the held long run can sit up to 10 minutes above the on-time step-back (GEN b=5, gap from week 2: LONG 65 against 55), identical on R7C-FREEZE-2. R4: the HOLD remains (Engineering); a known stop, an executed, a mixed or an adverse answer it records is applied by the next decision (no residual measured). R5: the eligibility flag records nothing, the re-send applies it; after a handler clinical route a known stop, an executed and an adverse answer are applied after clearance with no re-send, and a mixed answer is too except the residual in C3 (r5). SSCTR-SD5-02, narrowed (a held signal survives a change kept beside the question; it is still dropped by an answer inside a non-review kind that returns VALID). QE-R7C-05. Never reported, easy running: within the intake window a credited progression below the single-run ceiling, quality activation included, stands at non-review decisions until the week's own review (e.g. EASY 50/QUALITY 34/LONG 65 against the reviewed EASY 45/45/LONG 60). Never reported, restart or walk/jog: outside the unknown window by design; the restart ladder progresses on credit (EASY 20 to EASY 30/LONG 35 by week 5, against 15 on the reviewed path and the entry ceiling on the record) until the week's own review. The reach of the recorded-answer re-plan (R7C-FREEZE-3): a stored plan resting on projection over its run window follows the record at the first decision whose factual plan differs, never above R7C-FREEZE-2 or the single-run ceiling in any measured cell, and overperformance is not adopted outside a review; where weeks were never reviewed, the facts reading holds every run role (no step): after adverse long-run responses the long run stays at the stored dose where the weekly review would step it back (up to 10 minutes above the reviewed path), and a lift also executed in another session of the week keeps its executed load where the review holds it (24 against 22 kg); with an earlier evidence anchor in the window the projection still stands until the week's own review (Property B: the Saturday-only lift 24 kg against 22 kg in history); on the timely path, see C11.

conditions.text: On the timely, weekly-reviewed path, since R7C-FREEZE-3 a decision made before the week's review while a run session of the week has elapsed with no report re-plans the following week without crediting it: it holds the quality step (GEN THRESHOLD 3x10 back to the week's 4x8; R10K 5x4 back to 6x3; taper 3x4 to 3x3), and the week's review restores the progression once the reports arrive (24 of 210 measured cells change mid-week, 0 after the review). This is the accepted unknown semantics, not a new dose. Consumers present the following week's plan as provisional until the week's review and do not surface the interim hold as a coaching change; cadence and wording belong to G03.
